scope: Corollary 6.2 of the manuscript “Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties” (preprints/Milnes-rationality-conjecture-for-abelian-varieties-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 001 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640701a0ea8d8026), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The Lefschetz pairing property holds for the specialization of every rational Hodge class on a CM abelian variety over Q with good reduction at w.
